description: Write a reviewed plan to the target store. Refused unless the target has allowWrites=true. For a protected store the person is asked to confirm in the client (or applies from the command line); the assistant can't confirm on their behalf. Re-reads the target first and skips anything that changed since planning. Uploads missing files. Creates and updates only, never deletes. Every op is written to the audit log (get_audit_log). Returns { plan_id, status, totals (created, updated, skipped, failed), results per op }; a plan of more than 50 steps runs in the background instead and returns at once: follow it with apply_status and stop it with cancel_apply. A plan can be applied once, within an hour of plan_sync.

confirm.description: Leave empty. Only read when the server runs with SYNC_ALLOW_AGENT_CONFIRM=true (unattended automation); otherwise a protected store is confirmed by the person, not by this argument.

only.description: Apply only these ops, by their seq number in the plan (e.g. [1, 2, 3]). Default: every op.

plan_id.description: The plan to write, from plan_sync. It must not have been applied yet and must be less than an hour old.

wait.description: Wait for the whole apply before returning. By default a plan of more than 50 steps (SYNC_BACKGROUND_STEPS) runs in the background and this returns at once; follow it with apply_status.

name: apply_plan
title: Apply a plan
